```{r message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(data.table)
```

# COMPLEASM results

```{r echo=FALSE}
path <- '~/project_data/downy/oomycota-genome/compleasm/'
files <- list.files(path, pattern = 'csv', full.names = TRUE)
df <- map_dfr(files,
              function(x) {
                df <- fread(x) %>% 
                  mutate(file = str_remove(basename(x), '.csv')) %>% 
                  separate(file, into = c('species', 'linkage'), sep = '_')
              }) %>% select(-linkage)
```

## stramenopiles_odb10

```{r echo=FALSE}
df %>% 
  column_to_rownames('species') %>% 
  gt(rownames_to_stub = TRUE)
```
